key_learnings: Rebuilding on the live PR head in a clean worktree, with archive/pr4545-local-a0387bc21 pinning the old local tip, made the diverged local branch disposable instead of something to merge.

Cherry-picking five of six unpublished commits was the right split. The sixth lowered the Ruff baseline from 43 to 31, which is a policy change about main's ceiling, not part of this PR's correctness fix, so it belongs in its own review.
Mutation controls that fail on both restored defects are what separate a test that covers a fix from a test that merely runs beside it.
The root lefthook.yml change arrived through a recovered commit rather than a deliberate edit, so the security PIV requirement is easy to miss when reading only the final diff.
